  "evidence_ids": ["E1.1", "E2.1"],
  "reasons": [
    "The stem says the directors have not yet made the call. NCERT classifies money received before a call is made as Calls in Advance, a liability credited to that account.",
    "No calculation is needed; the ₹5,000 amount does not affect the classification."
  ],
  "syllabus_chapter": "Share Capital",
  "syllabus_topic": "Accounting treatment and classification of calls received in advance",
  "syllabus_entitlement": true,
  "presentation_ready": true,
  "question_type_match": true,
  "principle_applicability": "excerpt_required",
  "decisive_principle_in_excerpts": true,
  "answer_conditions": [
    {
      "condition": "The payment is received for a call that the directors have not yet made.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "condition": "A payment received before the call is made is Calls in Advance, credited to Calls in Advance and treated as a liability until adjusted when the call falls due.",
      "status": "convention",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": ["E1.1"]
    }
  ],
  "option_challenges": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "strongest_reading": "Eventual share-capital recognition might apply after the call falls due; the option instead says to credit it immediately, although the call is unmade.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "strongest_reading": "Calls in arrears concerns an amount due but unpaid; this amount is paid before the directors have made the call.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "strongest_reading": "A specifically identified share-issue premium might be credited to Securities Premium; the stem identifies this payment as advance money toward an unmade call.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    }
  ],
  "blocking_defects": [],
  "style_notes": [],

    "criteria": {
      "syllabus_objective": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "Tests the syllabus-named accounting treatment of calls in advance."
      },
      "format_authenticity": {
        "level": 3,

      },

        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "One-step recognition/application, within the easy conceptual range of Q6 and Q14."
      },
      "discrimination_value": {
        "level": 2,
        "evidence": "The alternatives test confusion with share capital, calls in arrears and securities premium."
      }
    },
    "reasoning_steps": 1,
    "estimated_difficulty": "easy",
    "cognitive_level": "application",

      "cuet2024-accountancy-bookA-q6",
      "cuet2024-accountancy-bookA-q14"
    ]
  },
  "option_resolution": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Credit it to Share Capital A/c immediately and treat it as part of owners' equity",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "The amount received in advance is a liability of the company and should be credited to ‘Call in Advance Account.”",
      "reason": "The excerpt requires liability treatment and credit to Calls in Advance, not immediate recognition as share capital."
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Credit it to Calls in Arrears A/c",
      "premise_source": "stem",
      "evidence_id": "",
      "premise_quote": "towards a call that the directors have not yet made.",
      "reason": "Calls in arrears concerns an amount due but unpaid (E2.1); this payment is for a call not yet made."
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "status": "supported",
      "false_part": "",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "The amount received in advance is a liability of the company and should be credited to ‘Call in Advance Account.”",
      "reason": "The excerpt supports crediting Calls in Advance and treating the pre-call receipt as a liability."
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Credit it to Securities Premium Reserve A/c",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "The amount so received from the shareholders is known as “Calls in Advance”. The amount received in advance is a liability of the company and should be credited to ‘Call in Advance Account.”",
      "reason": "The excerpt identifies this pre-call receipt as Calls in Advance and prescribes that account, not Securities Premium."
    }
  ]
}
